We are to be making our way to main cargo hold, here.  Master tells Raskuja this ship is to be belonging to Varanese traders. Clever, shrewd men with the coin to be hiring strrrrrong bodyguards.
We must to be splitting into thrrrrrree armies.  Raskuja is to be leading North group. We are to be needing brave warriors for West and South groups.
The humans think he can to be fooling Raskuja with silly puzzles and trrrricks. Blue button make blue spikes disappear, it should to be being much simple, yes?  Let us to be getting trrrreasure beyond wildest of dreams.
